baseline_comparisons.name: RevAudit 3-Level Mixed-Effects Model
baseline_comparisons.description: Partitions variance into patch churn/experience, reviewer bandwidth random effects, and repository governance policies.

baseline_comparisons.name: Baseline 1: Global Pooled OLS Regression
baseline_comparisons.description: Standard linear regression ignoring hierarchical clustering across reviewers and repositories.

baseline_comparisons.name: Baseline 2: Unadjusted Rolling Dashboard Model
baseline_comparisons.description: Raw unadjusted median/mean latency without controlling for patch size, subsystem, author experience, or concurrent load.

baseline_comparisons.name: Baseline 3: Literature Churn & Prior Acceptance Model
baseline_comparisons.description: Predicts turnaround latency purely based on author prior acceptance rates and lines added/deleted.

hypotheses.title: H1: Workload Saturation Driver
hypotheses.hypothesis: Turnaround latency and review iterations are significantly driven by concurrent reviewer workload, independent of patch size.
hypotheses.interpretation: Reviewers assigned >5 concurrent PRs experience super-linear turnaround delays regardless of whether patch churn is small (<50 lines) or large.

hypotheses.title: H2: Residual Cross-Repository Variance
hypotheses.hypothesis: Substantial residual variation in review turnaround persists across repositories after adjusting for patch churn and author experience.
hypotheses.interpretation: Repository-level governance (CI build test matrix runtime, required review quorum) accounts for a substantial proportion of latency variance.

hypotheses.title: H3: Blame-Free Anomaly Isolation
hypotheses.hypothesis: Multi-level hierarchical mixed-effects models isolate statistical process anomalies without ranking developers or assigning individual bias labels.
hypotheses.effect_size: 100% Synthetic Shift Recovery (2/2 detected, 0 false positives)
hypotheses.interpretation: Model successfully isolated synthetic +24.0h delays in numpy/numpy and django/django without triggering false positives across unshifted repos.
